title: MembershipChanged, as Reports reads it
description: Published by Auth & Users (farol.auth-users, routing key membership.changed), consumed from reports.auth-users-events. This is what Reports relies on; the producer's own contract (#191) wins where they differ. Full state with a version: Reports upserts its copy and ignores a version not newer than the one it has (API outline §7.3). Unknown fields are ignored.
